recommendations: Statements 1, 2, 6, 7 are syntactically identical between SQL Server and PostgreSQL but could not be verified by SQL Equivalency tool due to CTE/window function complexity. Recommend comprehensive integration testing.

All window functions (AVG OVER, COUNT OVER, LAG, RANK, PERCENT_RANK, MIN/MAX OVER) are supported by PostgreSQL and should work correctly, but require testing with actual data.
Verify PostgreSQL database has the same schema structure (Products, ProductHistory, ProductStats tables) with compatible column types.
Test with actual PostgreSQL database connection to verify NOW() function behavior and RETURNING clause functionality.
Review Npgsql 8.0.0 security vulnerability (GHSA-x9vc-6hfv-hg8c) and update to patched version if available.
Replace placeholder password in connection strings with secure credential management.
